blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term in searchUsers) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
return query<UserRow>(sql);
findings.recommendation: Bind the term as a parameter instead of concatenating it, as `query` in src/db.ts:5-6 requires ("values go in `params`, never in `sql`"): `query<UserRow>("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE $1 ORDER BY name LIMIT 50", ["%" + term + "%"])`. The length check in src/server.ts:14 (2 to 100 characters) does not prevent the attack. Also escape `%`, `_` and `\` in the term (with an `ESCAPE` clause) so they match literally, and add a test sending a quote in `q` that fails without the fix. CWE-89. An authenticated user with the `support` role sends `GET /users/search?q=' UNION SELECT id, password FROM users--` (well under 100 characters) and gets back any column of any table the database user can read, or alters data through stacked statements.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term in searchUsers
